subject: Login loops back to sign-in page after password reset
body: Users who reset their password get redirected to the sign-in page again in an endless loop. Happens in Chrome and Edge.

comments.author: agent
comments.text: Reproduced. The old session cookie survives the reset and fails validation.

resolution: Cleared stale session cookies on password reset; shipped in 4.2.1. Workaround: clear site data.

subject: CSV export missing rows over 10,000
body: Exporting the orders report to CSV stops at exactly 10,000 rows. The UI shows 14,212.

comments.author: agent
comments.text: Export uses the paginated API with a hard cap.

resolution: Export now streams all pages. Large exports are emailed as a link.

subject: Webhook deliveries failing with 401
body: Since this morning every webhook to our endpoint returns 401. Nothing changed on our side.

comments.author: agent
comments.text: Signing secret was rotated by an admin on their account.

resolution: Customer updated the signing secret on their receiver. Added an audit log entry for secret rotation.

subject: Dashboard charts blank in Safari
body: All charts on the analytics dashboard render empty in Safari 17. Chrome is fine.
resolution: Date parsing used a non-ISO format Safari rejects. Fixed in 4.3.0.

subject: Invoice PDF shows wrong currency symbol
body: Invoices for our EU entity show $ instead of EUR.
resolution: Invoice template now uses the billing entity currency.

subject: SSO login fails for new employees
body: New hires get 'user not provisioned' when signing in through Okta. Existing users are fine.

comments.author: agent
comments.text: SCIM provisioning job was paused after a token expired.

resolution: Renewed the SCIM token and re-ran provisioning. Added an alert when SCIM sync stops.

subject: API rate limit errors during nightly sync
body: Our nightly sync job gets HTTP 429 after about 5 minutes and aborts.
resolution: Recommended exponential backoff honoring Retry-After; raised their limit to 20 rps.

subject: Search returns no results for accented names
body: Searching for José or Zoë finds nothing, but Jose finds the record.
resolution: Search index now folds diacritics. Reindexed all accounts.

subject: Password reset email never arrives
body: Users request a password reset and never get the email. Not in spam either.

comments.author: agent
comments.text: Their mail gateway rejects our new sending domain.

resolution: Customer allowlisted the sending domain. Published SPF and DKIM guidance in the docs.

subject: Mobile app crashes on launch after update
body: After updating to 5.0 the Android app crashes immediately on launch for about a third of users.

comments.author: agent
comments.text: Crash in migration of the offline cache on Android 11.

resolution: Hotfix 5.0.1 skips the broken cache migration. Users on 5.0 should update.

subject: Bulk import times out for large spreadsheets
body: Importing a 60 MB spreadsheet fails with a gateway timeout.
resolution: Imports over 10 MB now run as a background job with progress emails.

subject: Two-factor codes rejected as invalid
body: Authenticator codes are always rejected for one user.
resolution: User enabled automatic time on the phone. Widened the accepted window to one step.

subject: Scheduled report emails sent twice
body: Every Monday the weekly report arrives twice.
resolution: Duplicate scheduler instance after a deploy. Added a lock so one job runs.

subject: Cannot remove a former admin
body: Deleting a user who was the last owner of a workspace fails with an error.
resolution: Transfer workspace ownership first; the error message now says so.

subject: Login loop in embedded iframe
body: When our portal embeds the app in an iframe, sign-in redirects forever.

comments.author: agent
comments.text: Third-party cookies blocked; session cookie lacks SameSite=None.

resolution: Session cookie set with SameSite=None; Secure for embedded mode.

subject: Timezone wrong on audit log
body: Audit log times are shown in UTC instead of our account timezone.

subject: Webhook retries flood our endpoint
body: After an outage on our side, webhook retries arrived all at once and overloaded us.
resolution: Retries now use jittered backoff and a per-endpoint concurrency cap.

subject: Export to Excel corrupts leading zeros
body: ZIP codes like 02139 lose the leading zero in the Excel export.
resolution: Text columns are now typed as text in XLSX exports.

subject: API returns 500 on large filter lists
body: Passing more than 500 ids in the filter parameter returns HTTP 500.

comments.author: agent
comments.text: Query planner limit; escalated to engineering.

resolution: see notes

subject: Okta SSO stopped working after certificate rotation
body: Nobody can sign in with SSO since the IdP certificate was rotated.
resolution: Uploaded the new IdP signing certificate. Metadata URL refresh is now supported.

subject: Mobile push notifications delayed
body: Push notifications arrive 10 to 30 minutes late on iOS.
resolution: APNs priority was set to low for all pushes; alerts now send with priority 10.

subject: Session expires too quickly
body: Users are logged out every 15 minutes even while active.
resolution: n/a

subject: Report totals differ from dashboard
body: The monthly revenue report total is lower than the dashboard number.
resolution: Report excluded refunds issued after month end; both now use the posting date.

subject: Accessibility: screen reader skips form labels
body: NVDA does not announce labels on the signup form.
resolution: Inputs now reference their labels with aria-labelledby.
